name: Duyet va tim kiem danh sach Product Base
user_goal: La owner, tim va xem danh sach product base hien co (theo tab Active/Archived, filter, search, tuy bien view list/grid) de tu do quan ly, tao moi, hoac thao tac len tung product base.

actors.permission_observed: Truy cap /products, doi tab Active/Archived, search/filter (bao gom 2 filter chip Internal name/tags), toggle view, dieu huong sang edit roi Back, khong gap access-denied.

entry_points.precondition: da dang nhap role owner (session hop le)
click '+ Add Manual' tren /products (cua ngo sang FEAT-02-product-base-create)

capabilities.name: Xem danh sach product base dang bang/grid
capabilities.description: Bang 8 cot co dinh (MOCKUP/TITLE-INTERNAL/INTERNAL TAGS/FULFILLMENT/IMPORTED/USED/CREATED AT/ACTION), khong cot nao sort duoc; co the toggle sang grid view.

capabilities.name: Loc theo tab Active/Archived
capabilities.description: Doi tab thay doi dieu kien GraphQL status _neq/_eq '1'.

capabilities.name: Search chung theo title
capabilities.description: O search chi loc title:{_ilike}, khong loc Internal name/tags.

capabilities.name: 4 filter chip
capabilities.description: Fulfillment (radio 1-chon 16 provider + Clear), Internal name (textbox), Internal tags (textbox), Usage (radio Used/Unused + Clear). 2 chip Internal name/Internal tags da duoc test that: loc dung field rieng (label/internal_tags), doc lap voi Search chung.

capabilities.name: Phan trang cursor (products_connection)
capabilities.description: Nhat quan qua 4 lan refetch khac thoi diem; chi co control '‹ ›', khong co so trang. Hanh vi khi store co >20 ban ghi VAN CHUA kiem duoc (xem unknown_areas, blocked ca 2 lần khảo sát).

capabilities.name: Row-level action controls
capabilities.description: Icon rocket 'Update campaign' (co dieu kien), pencil 'Edit product', copy 'Duplicate product', menu '...' (noi dung khac nhau giua tab Active/Archived).

capabilities.name: 2 empty-state message phan biet nguyen nhan rong
capabilities.description: 'Empty data' khi tab rong that; 'No data matched' khi search/filter khong khop.

capabilities.name: Entry point tao moi / import product base
capabilities.description: '+ Add Manual' -> /products/new; 'Import product' -> modal voi 15 provider, catalog phan trang offset.

capabilities.name: URL-sync back-restore filter/trang khi roi trang edit roi Back
capabilities.description: Roi /products (voi ?tab=&limit=&title=&cursor=&gridstate=) sang /products/{id}/edit roi bam Back trinh duyet: URL va tab active duoc khoi phuc CHINH XAC gia tri cu. Co che la browser history tu khoi phuc vi state nam trong query string, khong phai logic back-restore rieng cua app.

state_transitions.trigger: khong con ban ghi nao status=archived

state_transitions.condition: URL cu duoc luu trong browser history

state_transitions.trigger: bam nut Back cua trinh duyet
state_transitions.condition: browser history tu khoi phuc URL, tab Archived van active

confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-01-011] Roi /products (dang co tab/filter/trang cu the trong URL) sang /products/{id}/edit roi bam Back trinh duyet: URL va tab active duoc khoi phuc CHINH XAC gia tri truoc do (cung gridstate). Day la co che browser history dua tren URL-sync (query string), khong phai logic rieng cua app.

observed_behavior.statement: Ten trang khong nhat quan: sidebar 'Product Base', breadcrumb 'Home / Products', heading 'Product Bases'.
8 cot bang co dinh, khong cot nao sort duoc; order_by mac dinh {id: desc}.
Cot IMPORTED/USED hien o rong (khong phai false/0) cho product base tao tay; product imported hien 'true' va so luot dung.
Khong co checkbox chon dong / bulk action nao.
Menu '...' khac noi dung giua tab Active ('Mark as archive') va Archived ('Unarchive').
Danh sach fulfillment provider khong nhat quan giua 3 noi hien thi: filter (16, co Myze), modal Import (15, khong Myze), dropdown /products/new (32).
4 lan refetch khac nhau xac nhan nhat quan co che cursor pagination (products_connection), khong co so trang.
Toggle list/grid khong phan anh vao URL; chi grid moi co dong 'Showing X to Y of Z entries'.
Modal Import product dung phan trang offset (GET.../catalogs?page&per_page), khac co che cursor cua list chinh.
Role owner (sub=273) truy cap moi route da thu ma khong gap access-denied.

[CHK-01-010] 2 filter chip 'Internal name'/'Internal tags' loc dung field rieng (label/internal_tags), doc lap hoan toan voi Search chung (cung tu khoa 'ZEBRA' cho ket qua khac nhau giua filter chip va Search chung). PO chi tra loi 'can explore ky hon' (khong phai assertion cu the ve ket qua), nen giu OBSERVED_CURRENT du evidence ro rang.

observed_validations.input: go nguyen van Internal name hop le cua 1 product base vao o Search chung

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner, sub=273); khong co 401/403/cross-tenant nao trong lần khảo sát nay;.env chi con TIB_STAGING_*, khong con TIB_USER_A_*/TIB_USER_B_*.

portal.item: /products (list, filter, tab, search, view toggle, back-restore)

data.item: products.title (duy nhat field duoc Search chung loc)

dependencies.relation: entry_point ('+ Add Manual' dan sang form tao moi)
entry_point (icon rocket 'Update campaign' hien co dieu kien, mo modal that trong lần khảo sát nay)

risks.risk: CONF-001 chua duoc resolve chinh thuc (qua orchestrator+reviewer): URL-sync cua /products co the de lai cursor stale neu tao product base moi trong luc user dang o trang edit roi quay lai bang URL cu. Phia B cua conflict (URL-sync co chu dich) DA duoc re-verify doc lap trong lần khảo sát nay va khop; dieu kien mo rong sang /campaigns/orders VAN CHUA xac minh.
Danh sach fulfillment provider khong dong nhat giua 3 UI surface (16/15/32) co the khien user chon nham provider khi tao/import product base.
Ten trang khong nhat quan (Product Base / Products / Product Bases) co the gay nham lan tai lieu/test case.

unknown_areas.question: Cursor pagination hoat dong the nao khi >20 ban ghi (nut '‹ ›' that su chuyen trang ra sao)? [CHK-01-009]
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Store hien chi co vai ban ghi test nen chua tung thay trang 2; day la core navigation cho store lon. KHONG co evidence moi trong lần khảo sát - BLOCKED do permission/platform classifier ha tang khi thu dung account store B (khong lien quan business rule). Giu NGUYEN trang thai cu tu v1, can chay bo sung khi permission duoc mo.

unknown_areas.question: Rui ro cursor bi stale khi store co >20 ban ghi va dung account store B (linh-tib-staging)? [CHK-01-012]
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: PO de nghi test tren store B nhung CHUA thuc hien duoc trong lần khảo sát (BLOCKED tuong tu CHK-01-009). Giu NGUYEN trang thai cu tu v1, can chay bo sung sau khi permission classifier duoc xu ly.

unknown_areas.question: Cursor co thuc su bi stale khi tao moi product base trong luc dang o trang edit roi quay lai /products bang URL cu khong?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Rui ro domain-expert neu ra trong resolution cua CONF-001, nhung chua tai hien bang evidence that trong ca 2 lần khảo sát.

unknown_areas.question: Role khac owner (vd staff quyen han che) co bi chan o /products hay bi an bot filter/control nao khong?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Chi 1 account test duoc trong ca 2 lần khảo sát (.env chi con TIB_STAGING_*) - khong co coverage permission theo role.

unknown_areas.question: Import product base tu catalog nha in qua modal Import co hoat dong dung va validate gi khong?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: Goi API ben thu ba, ngoai scope ca 2 lần khảo sát, nhung la entry point chinh de nhap hang loat san pham (coverage_gap).
